claim: The retained edition is Requirements Document 6 February 2019; its official index lists supporting draft requirements and history labels Supports Public Working Draft.
not_concluded: A Recommendation, current universal status, normative algorithm or installed implementation

claim: The proposal distinguishes modelling relationships from applying validation to reported facts.
not_concluded: Removing inconsistent relations is justified for AccDSL reconstruction

claim: Concept rollups keep non-concept OIM aspects equal, restrict signs to +/-1 and exclude specified period/datatype combinations.
not_concluded: A label match licenses unit, basis, entity or measurement conversion

claim: Dimensional aggregation needs a specified domain and concept-sensitive permission; alternative hierarchies stay segregated.
not_concluded: All numeric members or EPS across share classes can be summed

claim: Typed dimensions may aggregate to an absent dimension; a nil typed value is distinct and aggregation to it is excluded.
not_concluded: Nil typed totals or nil numeric values are zero

claim: The proposal includes instant/duration roll-forwards, consecutive shorter periods, combined relation types and unreported intermediate subtotals.
not_concluded: A subtotal identifies underlying transactions or a unique economic history

claim: Calculation completeness is a fact-set question; the proposal requests preparer sections and treats nil fact values as unknown.
not_concluded: A taxonomy or filing indicator proves all contributors have been reported

claim: The 2019 text requests intervals and report-level rounding, but its most-precise duplicate rule differs from final Calculations 1.1 interval intersection.
not_concluded: Adoption of the 2019 rule, resolution of 1.1 section 5.4, or a new numerical test

claim: Cross-entity/unit calculations, weighted-member cases, nil typed totals and filing-indicator completeness are excluded or redirected in the described scope.
not_concluded: Consolidation eliminations, currency conversion or weighted averages are supplied

claim: The text permits explicit balance-check overrides, calls for OIM-only information and regards simple visual relationships as a design aim.
not_concluded: Formula capabilities independently checked or debit/credit semantics waived

claim: Calculations 1.1 explicitly excludes the broader cross-period/dimensional functionality proposed here.
not_concluded: The later 1.1 specification implements the earlier 2.0 proposal

claim: Before any reported relation constrains company histories, AccDSL must establish compatible context, coverage, time, perimeter, measurement and branch-dependent economic assumptions, retaining derived status and joint dependence.
not_concluded: The requirements prove accounting correctness, history completeness, probabilities or default readiness
